items.title: Eddie Alley interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Francisco, California, August 8, 2002
items.q: Harold Brown the trombone player in Duke Ellington, he was another personal friend of mine

ctx.x: Yeah. It was a popular song and he swung it, you know? It was just different. Jimmie Lunceford was my man. And then naturally we had to play a lot of Duke Ellington tunes because Harold Brown the trombone player in Duke Ellington, he was another personal friend of mine, I’d put his name down there. Did you ever hear of Harold Brown the trombone player?
